text:
maria: Quick check — we plan to cut release/1.13.0 today EOD PDT. Two quick asks: 1) Confirm version-bump strategy (where to bump package.json/pyproject vs build pipeline). 2) Backport rules: do we accept semver-patch bug fixes only or small refactors? Also any changelog format preference? @alex you're cut owner, pinging.

alex: Thanks — yes cut owner here. Plan: branch goes out after we merge the final RC PRs. Version bumps should be done in the release branch only (single commit bump in build files). We avoid bumping across multiple packages; do a centralized bump if possible.

alex: Backport policy: Only bugfixes that fix regressions or security issues get automatic backports. Docs/xdoc and localization changes are not backported unless requested. For anything larger, open a backport request PR and add label `backport-request` and target release branch. Keep PRs tiny.

maria: Got it. For the centralized bump, I can add the commit on the branch after creation.

sam: Quick changelog Q — should we squash multiple small entries into a single "chore/release" bullet? We have several infra tweaks.

alex: For changelog: yes prefer grouped entries per component. Use the "Unreleased -> 1.13.0" header and list bullets. If it's infra-only, put under INTERNAL.

kevin: heads-up: upstream flake in `tests/kv_cache` is failing on main, will probably need cherry-pick. I can try to backport the test fix but need guidance on CI config differences for release branches.

jen: I can own cherry-picks for kernel/runtime changes. Ping me the PRs and I'll queue them. For backports, use label `backport: 1.13` and add reviewer @jen.

kevin: thanks — I'll open a PR and include the test log. Use commit message prefix `cherry-pick(regression): ` so release tools pick it up.

alex: Ops reminder — cutoff for merging to release/1.13.0 is 18:00 PDT today. After that, only critical backports via triage channel.

release-bot: :rotating_light: Branch window reminder — 6 hours until the release branch cut for 1.13.0. Visit https://internal/release/1.13 for checklist.

maria: I'll create the branch at 17:50 PDT and push the bump commit, then open the release PR. Leaving a note here when done.

ci-bot: test-run triggered: release/1.13.0 pipeline queued.

jen: re: cherry-picks queue — please add `cherry-pick-needed` label and put a short description of root cause in the PR body. That speeds triage.

sam: OK copying the changelog template into the release PR.

maria: Branch created and pushed: `git checkout -b release/1.13.0 && git push origin release/1.13.0`. Opened release PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 :tada:

alex: Thanks all — monitoring the backport queue. If anything blocks CI I'll call a triage meeting but let's keep it async unless it's blocking.

maria: closing loop: will post final release PR link here and tag docs and release notes owner. :wave:
